### ✨ Kritika Mod Menu (v5.32.1)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **Kritika: The White Knights** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode & 0 Cooldown (Player Only)** — Auto-Unlinked: Player takes 0 damage & skills have 0s cooldown
- **Unlimited Energy / Stamina & 0 Ability Cost** — Locks character stamina at maximum (UpdateCurrentCharacterStaminaMax)
- **One-Hit Kill Enemies** — Deals instant 999,999 damage to non-player enemy targets
- **Damage & Reward Multiplier (1x - 100x)** — Scales ObjectBase.GetBaseDamage, AddExpAccount, AddExp & AddExpCharacter
- **High Attack & Crit Stat Boost** — Boosts PlayerController.SetDamage & get_AttackDamage

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
